name: Seeds Performance
description: Starter Module to enable all performance modules
project_description: Seeds Performance is a starter (metapackage) module from the Seeds distribution whose only job is to pull in and enable a curated stack of performance modules so a Drupal site gets a sensible performance baseline in one step. The module itself ships no PHP code, routes, services, or configuration; its seeds_performance.module file is an empty stub and there is no src/ or config/ directory. Its seeds_performance.info.yml declares dependencies on webp and ultimate_cron, so enabling the single Seeds Performance module turns those on together, while its composer.json additionally requires minifyhtml into the codebase for optional use. All actual behaviour, configuration, and any security surface belong to the depended-on modules.
